Australian PM Warns UN on AI Pace After Medicare Breach

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese addressed the UN General Assembly in New York City, warning about the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence. He cited the recent AI hack of Medicare as an example necessitating stronger AI regulation, stating, 'We can’t ignore AI or prevent it.' Australia has joined other nations in calling for increased oversight of AI.
